reason: The README clearly presents dsh-assembler as an agent orchestration plugin that converts natural-language requirements into verified single- or multi-agent presets, integrating cataloged MCP capabilities and producing delivery artifacts and web interfaces.

summaries.zh: 将自然语言需求组装为经过会话验证的单个或多智能体预设，并整合目录中的 MCP 能力与交付产物。
summaries.en: Assembles natural-language requirements into session-verified single- or multi-agent presets using cataloged MCP capabilities and delivery artifacts.

capabilities: Composes agent presets from natural-language requirements
Matches and mounts capability catalog components including MCP servers
Runs verification probes in real agent sessions
Builds multi-agent solutions with shared databases and handover artifacts
Copies knowledge packs into presets and writes assembly logs, manifests, and reports
Serves generated web frontends for assembled agents
May connect assembled agents to external APIs and services when configured
